benchmarkRateContract.SUBJECT_RATE_FORMULA: SUBJECT_AI_PRESENCE_RATE = comparable observations where the subject hotel appears / all comparable observations, at property × territory × provider × period. All Providers = equal mean of included provider subject rates. Missing provider is omitted, not zero.
benchmarkRateContract.CORE_BENCHMARK_FORMULA: CORE_BENCHMARK_AI_PRESENCE_RATE = arithmetic mean of presence rates of every valid CORE peer in the same property × territory × provider × period grain. Zero-presence CORE peers remain in the mean. Secondary peers are excluded (weight 0). All Providers = equal mean of included provider CORE means.
benchmarkRateContract.ALL_PROVIDERS_METHOD: A_EQUAL_MEAN_OF_INCLUDED_PROVIDER_RATES (same derivation as Presence Index V2 All Providers; rates are the customer numbers, index is not)
benchmarkRateContract.SUBJECT_CUSTOMER_QUESTION: How often does this hotel appear in AI responses for this demand territory?
benchmarkRateContract.CORE_BENCHMARK_CUSTOMER_QUESTION: How often do comparable hotels appear on average in the same monitored territory and provider scope?
benchmarkRateContract.supportingDifferencePp: Useful as a third column; not a substitute for showing both rates.
